g.text: One product drawn by the parts it was composed from: each boundary is a part of the library (the API, the web channel, the datastore, the event publisher), and what sits inside it is what that part made. A system in no boundary was written by hand or came from the landing zone.
The same product as the architecture view, cut the other way: not where things run, but which decision in the library put them there.
